content:
“The knights had it right!”

**Ironclad** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases all resistances provided by body suits, armor and power armor.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Armor provides 25% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set. | 003440D3 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Armor provides 20% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set. | 003440D2 | 
| ★ | 1 | Armor provides 15% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set. | 003440D0 | 

- Resistances provided from non-conditional modifications or specific legendary armor mods are also increased by the perk.
- Resistances gained from underarmor, backpack or other perks and effects are not affected by the perk.
